### If You Want Peace
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/if-you-want-peace-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-december-1-2020.html
Passage: Romans 5:1
Points:
- Placing faith in Jesus lifts the heavy burden and guilt of sin.
- Experiencing the personal peace of God requires first having objective peace with God.
- Justification through Christ ends hostility and restores friendship between God and humanity.
- God's peace surpasses human comprehension and remains steady regardless of circumstances.
- Believers receive divine peace and strength precisely when they need it most.

### Your Suffering Is Never Wasted
Author: Betsy St. Amant Haddox
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-october-27.html
Passage: Romans 5:3-4
Points:
- Suffering includes daily frustrations and minor distresses, not just catastrophic life events.
- Viewing ordinary hardships through Scripture reframes irritation into opportunities to grow in endurance.
- Navigating trials with faith refines personal character and generates resilient hope.
- Difficult seasons pull believers out of spiritual apathy into deeper reliance on God's Word.
- God wastes no suffering, using every affliction for the believer's good and His glory.
